subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic-hosted web_fetch and code_execution/PTC with allowed_callers, and what opt-in, replay, billing, and security policy should govern that support?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing provider-hosted execution semantics changes public config, tool permissions, billing visibility, and transcript state, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
options.body: Define an explicit Anthropic plugin/API surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

options.title: Split narrow trackers
options.body: Let the narrower native web_search and advisor/server-block issues proceed separately while deferring web_fetch and code_execution/PTC to later product decisions.

options.title: Defer hosted execution
options.body: Keep OpenClaw on client-side fetch/search and existing xAI code_execution for now, without Anthropic code_execution/PTC support.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
recommendation.body: Define an explicit Anthropic plugin/API surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most recent visible review context and provider/plugin boundary history for the affected Anthropic surfaces.
